name: Victor von Doom / Doctor Doom
description: Portrayed by Robert Downey Jr. (Confirmed). Main antagonist; ruler of Latveria and master of dark sorcery and advanced science (distinct from Tony Stark despite sharing his face). Gathering reality-altering assets across universes—approaching Franklin Richards on Earth-828, abducting Bruce Banner in Endgame: Encore, and resurrecting Wanda Maximoff in VisionQuest.

name: Sam Wilson / Captain America
description: Portrayed by Anthony Mackie (Confirmed - Earth-616). Leads the official Avengers team while locked in a trademark dispute with the New Avengers.

name: Steve Rogers (Nomad)
description: Portrayed by Chris Evans (Confirmed - Earth-616 / Branched 1940s Timeline). Returns after living in the 1940s timeline with Peggy Carter; heavily rumored to operate under the Nomad mantle.

name: Peggy Carter
description: Portrayed by Hayley Atwell (Confirmed - Branched 1940s Timeline). Lives with Steve Rogers in the branched 1940s timeline.

name: Thor Odinson
description: Portrayed by Chris Hemsworth (Confirmed - Earth-616). Returns with his more serious Infinity War-era warrior mindset to protect the multiverse and his adoptive daughter, Love.

name: Love
description: Portrayed by India Rose Hemsworth (Confirmed - Earth-616). Thor’s adoptive daughter born from Eternity, possessing cosmic power.

name: Bruce Banner / Hulk
description: Portrayed by Mark Ruffalo (Confirmed - Earth-616). Abducted by Doctor Doom from his underground bunker in the Avengers: Endgame Encore post-credits scene.

name: Scott Lang / Ant-Man
description: Portrayed by Paul Rudd (Confirmed - Earth-616). Part of Sam Wilson's core Avengers lineup after surviving his clash with Kang in the Quantum Realm.

name: Cassie Lang
description: Portrayed by Kathryn Newton (Confirmed - Earth-616). Joins her father Scott Lang in the multiversal defense.

name: Shang-Chi
description: Portrayed by Simu Liu (Confirmed - Earth-616). Joins Sam Wilson’s Avengers; his Ten Rings are actively transmitting a beacon across space-time.

name: Joaquín Torres / Falcon
description: Portrayed by Danny Ramirez (Confirmed - Earth-616). Sam Wilson's wingman and member of the official Avengers roster.

name: Doctor Stephen Strange
description: Portrayed by Benedict Cumberbatch (Confirmed - Earth-616). Master of the Mystic Arts last seen entering the Dark Dimension with Clea to repair an Incursion he caused.

name: America Chavez
description: Portrayed by Xochitl Gomez (Confirmed - Earth-616). Master of the Mystic Arts capable of punching star-shaped portals between universes.

name: Yelena Belova / Black Widow
description: Portrayed by Florence Pugh (Confirmed - Earth-616 New Avengers). Co-leads the Watchtower-based New Avengers team and helps anchor the film's emotional core.

name: Bucky Barnes / Winter Soldier
description: Portrayed by Sebastian Stan (Confirmed - Earth-616 New Avengers). Veteran strategist operating alongside the New Avengers.

name: Bob Reynolds / Sentry
description: Portrayed by Lewis Pullman (Confirmed - Earth-616 New Avengers). Possesses the power of 'a million exploding suns,' though he avoids using his powers out of fear of unleashing The Void.

name: John Walker / U.S. Agent
description: Portrayed by Wyatt Russell (Confirmed - Earth-616 New Avengers). Enhanced super-soldier on the Watchtower New Avengers roster.

name: Alexei Shostakov / Red Guardian
description: Portrayed by David Harbour (Confirmed - Earth-616 New Avengers). Veteran super-soldier pushing the 'New Avengerz' rebrand.

name: Ava Starr / Ghost
description: Portrayed by Hannah John-Kamen (Confirmed - Earth-616 New Avengers). Quantum-phasing operative on the Watchtower team.

name: Shuri / Black Panther
description: Portrayed by Letitia Wright (Confirmed - Earth-616 Wakanda). Protector of Wakanda coordinating with Talokan and welcoming Ben Grimm.

name: M'Baku
description: Portrayed by Winston Duke (Confirmed - Earth-616 Wakanda). Ruling King of Wakanda leading Wakandan forces into the conflict.

name: Namor
description: Portrayed by Tenoch Huerta Mejía (Confirmed - Earth-616 Talokan). Ruler of the underwater kingdom of Talokan, forming an uneasy alliance with Wakanda.

name: Namora
description: Portrayed by Mabel Cadena (Confirmed - Earth-616 Talokan). Talokanil general fighting alongside Namor.

name: Attuma
description: Portrayed by Alex Livinalli (Confirmed - Earth-616 Talokan). Talokanil general fighting alongside Namor.

name: Reed Richards / Mister Fantastic
description: Portrayed by Pedro Pascal (Confirmed - Earth-828 Fantastic Four). Scientific leader of the Fantastic Four who shares a deep intellectual and personal history with Victor von Doom.

name: Sue Storm / Invisible Woman
description: Portrayed by Vanessa Kirby (Confirmed - Earth-828 Fantastic Four). Co-leader of the Fantastic Four and mother of Franklin Richards, whom Doom visits in The Fantastic Four: First Steps.

name: Johnny Storm / Human Torch
description: Portrayed by Joseph Quinn (Confirmed - Earth-828 Fantastic Four). Piloted and crewed the Excelsior spacecraft into Earth-616's atmosphere.

name: Ben Grimm / The Thing
description: Portrayed by Ebon Moss-Bachrach (Confirmed - Earth-828 Fantastic Four). Arrives in Wakanda to meet M'Baku and Namor.

name: H.E.R.B.I.E.
description: Voiced by Matthew Wood (Confirmed - Earth-828 Fantastic Four). The Fantastic Four's loyal robot assistant aboard their spacecraft.

name: Franklin Richards
description: Unannounced child actor (Confirmed - Earth-828 Fantastic Four). Four-year-old son of Reed Richards and Sue Storm with reality-warping Power Cosmic abilities; a primary target for Doctor Doom.

name: Charles Xavier / Professor X
description: Portrayed by Patrick Stewart (Confirmed - Earth-10005 X-Men). Telepathic founder of the X-Men defending Earth-10005 as it collides with Earth-616.

name: Erik Lehnsherr / Magneto
description: Portrayed by Ian McKellen (Confirmed - Earth-10005 X-Men). Master of magnetism standing alongside Xavier against the multiversal threat.

name: Scott Summers / Cyclops
description: Portrayed by James Marsden (Confirmed - Earth-10005 X-Men). Field leader of the X-Men.

name: Hank McCoy / Beast
description: Portrayed by Kelsey Grammer (Confirmed - Earth-10005 X-Men). Scientist treating Monica Rambeau at the X-Mansion after The Marvels.

name: Kurt Wagner / Nightcrawler
description: Portrayed by Alan Cumming (Confirmed - Earth-10005 X-Men). Teleporting mutant returning from X2.

name: Raven Darkhölme / Mystique
description: Portrayed by Rebecca Romijn (Confirmed - Earth-10005 X-Men). Shape-shifting mutant; rumored to infiltrate Earth-616 by impersonating Yelena Belova.

name: Remy LeBeau / Gambit
description: Portrayed by Channing Tatum (Confirmed - Earth-10005 X-Men). Kinetic-charging mutant who survived the Void in Deadpool & Wolverine; plays a serious, fully realized role.

name: God Loki
description: Portrayed by Tom Hiddleston (Confirmed - End of Time / TVA). Sits at the End of Time physically holding the multiverse's Yggdrasil branches together, making him Doom's ultimate obstacle.

name: Wanda Maximoff / Scarlet Witch
description: Portrayed by Elizabeth Olsen (Rumored / Near-Certain - Earth-616). Resurrected by Doctor Doom with green magic in the VisionQuest finale post-credits scene, likely serving as Doom's coerced Chaos Magic enforcer.

name: Deadpool (Wade Wilson)
description: Portrayed by Ryan Reynolds (Rumored / Near-Certain - Earth-10005). Teased involvement at D23 2026 and credited with contributing additional dialogue/material to the script; essential to Earth-10005's survival.

name: Wolverine (Logan)
description: Portrayed by Hugh Jackman (Rumored / Near-Certain - Earth-10005). Teased involvement at D23 2026; anchor being alongside Deadpool fighting to save Earth-10005.

name: Monica Rambeau
description: Portrayed by Teyonah Parris (Rumored / Highly Likely - Earth-616 / Earth-10005). Stranded inside Earth-10005's X-Mansion with Beast, acting as the bridge between Earth-616 and the X-Men.

name: Maria Rambeau / Binary
description: Portrayed by Lashana Lynch (Rumored / Highly Likely - Earth-10005). Variant of Maria Rambeau operating as Binary alongside Beast at the X-Mansion.

name: Peter Parker / Spider-Man
description: Portrayed by Tom Holland (Rumored - Earth-616). Last seen abruptly transported into space in the Spider-Man: Brand New Day post-credits scene; insiders debate whether he makes a late entrance in Doomsday or leads Secret Wars.

name: Peter Parker / Spider-Man (Tobey Maguire)
description: Portrayed by Tobey Maguire (Rumored - Raimiverse). Scooper outlets claim his universe is directly involved in the Incursion clash alongside Earth-10005.

name: Carol Danvers / Captain Marvel
description: Portrayed by Brie Larson (Rumored - Earth-616). Tied directly to searching for Monica Rambeau and investigating the Quantum Bands' space-time tear.

name: Kamala Khan / Ms. Marvel
description: Portrayed by Iman Vellani (Rumored - Earth-616). Wielder of the Quantum Bands connected to the space-time tear into Earth-10005.

name: Mobius M. Mobius
description: Portrayed by Owen Wilson (Rumored - TVA). Expected to appear at the TVA monitoring the 3,000+ Incursions seen in Avengers: Endgame Encore.

name: Ouroboros (O.B.)
description: Portrayed by Ke Huy Quan (Rumored - TVA). Expected to appear at the TVA tracking the multiversal Incursion cascade alongside Mobius.

name: Clea
description: Portrayed by Charlize Theron (Rumored - Dark Dimension). Accompanied Doctor Strange into the Dark Dimension to stop an Incursion.

name: Ororo Munroe / Storm
description: Portrayed by Halle Berry (Rumored - Earth-10005). Expected to appear alongside the classic Fox X-Men during the Earth-10005 conflict.

name: Jean Grey
description: Portrayed by Famke Janssen or Sadie Sink (Rumored - Earth-10005 / Earth-616). Rumored to appear either as the classic Earth-10005 X-Men telepath or Sadie Sink's variant introduced in Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

name: The Latverian Witches (Green, Orange, Purple)
description: Unannounced actors (Rumored / Casting Listing - Latveria). Production listings note three mystical coven members serving Doctor Doom in Latveria.
